_comment: Template. `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m agentic init` (Git Bash) copies it to private/agentic/config.json (gitignored). Fill in the account numbers there, never here. live=false is shadow mode: plans are written and previewed, but the hook blocks every place_* call.

capital._comment: The sleeve deploys min(agentic account total value, max_usd).

allocation._comment: slots: every enabled asset's full position is slot_frac x capital (alloc_frac is ignored): 0.10 = 10 slots of 10% (slot_frac must be at most limits.max_asset_frac). Held positions keep their whole slot; the rest of capital goes to new entries in priority order (a partial slot only if at least half a slot is left). class_max_frac caps each class's share of capital (1.0 = no cap). method fixed: per-asset alloc_frac, class caps scale targets down. README section 9.
allocation._comment_favorites: Asset names (coins and tickers, any case), earlier first, e.g. ["ETH", "AAA"]. (1) Tie-break for new slots: class priority, then the newest green flip, then favorites, then config order, then liquidity, then name; it never makes an asset eligible, never overrides caps, entry rules or slots, and never trims a holding. (2) The crypto and stock universes always scan a favorite: it skips their min_dollar_volume_usd and max_assets cuts and does not count against max_assets (max_assets keeps the most liquid non-favorites). Every other filter still applies: on Robinhood (tradable pair or get_equity_tradability), a Coinbase pair or stock bars, min_history_bars, not pegged, not in exclude, explicit assets first, the ETF tradability check; a stock must be in universe.equity.symbols. A stock universe ticker also answers to TICKER-STOCK, whatever its name (it is named so on runs where the crypto universe has the coin of that code); a bare name that is both a Robinhood coin and a ticker in universe.equity.symbols means the stock to the scans (the coin is not kept past a cut), and in the tie-break the asset of that name. README section 9.

entry._comment: Joining a green run late (README section 9). join_recent: buy a green tranche only within max_join_bars bars of its own green flip and while its close is at most max_join_rise_frac above the flip close (0.50 = 50%; null = no rise cap). join: any time. fresh_only: join_recent, and only flips on or after start_date (null = the first live plan's date). An asset may override any key with its own "entry". Held positions are never sold because their run is old or has risen far.

crypto._comment: Scan every coin Robinhood offers (README section 10). source robinhood: the USD pairs of the newest get_currency_pairs capture that are tradable (fetch-list captures it), plus symbols; source list: symbols only. Filters: exclude, a Coinbase <CODE>-USD pair, min_history_bars (null = limits.min_bars), min_dollar_volume_usd (median daily volume on Coinbase over the last 30 bars), then the max_assets most liquid. A coin in etf_map trades that spot ETF when get_equity_tradability confirms it on the account (else it is watched only, never switched to direct crypto); other coins trade directly (about 0.95% per side) if direct_crypto. An explicit asset with the coin's name, or trading the same vehicle, takes precedence; a disabled one keeps the coin out.

equity._comment: Your own stock list (README section 13): put the tickers in symbols here, in this private config only (the repo is public). feed yfinance: Python downloads daily bars itself (.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install yfinance) and the plan checks the last close against Robinhood's before any buy; feed robinhood: bars through Claude's captures. Each ticker needs get_equity_tradability on the account (fractional, else whole shares), min_history_bars (younger listings are watch-only), min_dollar_volume_usd (median close x volume over 30 bars), then the max_assets most liquid. An explicit asset with the ticker's name or vehicle takes precedence; a disabled one keeps the ticker out. Held tickers are never dropped (exits only).

sleeve_initial_qty._comment: Shares the account already holds when the first reconcile runs belong to you, not the sleeve, and are never sold by the plan. To hand some to the sleeve, list them here before that first reconcile, e.g. "ETHA": 9.

modes._comment_immediate: full position on the first close beyond the line (N=1)
modes._comment_split: half on the first close beyond the line, the other half after 5 consecutive closes beyond it

_comment_assets: With the crypto universe enabled, explicit crypto entries are optional overrides: an enabled one trades the coin with its own settings, a disabled one keeps the coin out of the universe (delete it to let the universe trade the coin).

assets.name: ETH
assets._comment: Signal from Coinbase ETH-USD daily candles (TradingView COINBASE:ETHUSD); traded through the spot ETF at ~0 cost in the next NYSE session (gate.py: ETH = TRADE via ETF).

assets.name: SOL
assets._comment: PROBATION in gate.py (short history). Disabled, so it keeps SOL out of the universe; delete this entry to let the universe trade SOL (through BSOL), or enable it. Direct crypto ("vehicle": {"type": "crypto", "symbol": "SOL"}) costs ~0.95% per side on Robinhood's default route.

assets.name: BTC
assets._comment: NO-SIGNAL in gate.py (holding beat the signal after tax). Disabled, so it keeps BTC out of the universe; delete this entry to let the universe trade BTC (through IBIT).

assets.name: SPY
assets._comment: Stocks: the 5-close delay helped in the flip-delay study (section 5.15), but no timing rule beat holding after tax.

assets.name: ETH-TV
assets._comment: Follows the NEW (Oct 2026) TradingView MoneyLine from a fresh daily CSV export (Direction / ConfirmCount / MoneyLine Level columns). Enable this OR the computed ETH entry, not both.
